_comment: BSA plugin hooks (US-S4-03). Three hooks enforce pipeline invariants at the Claude Code event layer before any per-skill logic runs. See skills/bsa-orchestrator/references/ for the invariants each hook protects.

PreToolUse._comment: Single-writer canonical enforcement (INV-02). Blocks any Write or Edit targeting analysis/canonical/* unless the caller identifies as bsa-orchestrator via the BSA_WRITER env var. Hook exit 0 allows, non-zero blocks with the script's stderr surfaced to Claude.

Marker-gate enforcement on /bsa-promote (two-key promotion). Intercepts Bash calls whose command string invokes bsa-promote and verifies required markers exist BEFORE the orchestrator's own precondition check. Belt-and-suspenders with the command-level check in commands/bsa-promote.md.
